name: Aucnet Inc.
summary: Aucnet Inc., a circular market design company, engages in online auctions and various distribution businesses for goods, flowers, used motorcycles, used medical equipment, and other products in Japan. The company operates through Lifestyle Products and Mobility & Energy segments. It is involved in used motorcycle and flower auctions and circular commerce business; fashion resale business; agricultural business, such as cut and potted flowers; and digital devices, such as used PCs and mobile phones. The company was formerly known as FTS Inc. and changed its name to Aucnet Inc. in September 1984. Aucnet Inc. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
